info.title: PeopleSoft Query Access Service over REST: the response read by frappe-idempotent-importer
info.description: PeopleSoft publishes no OpenAPI document for its Integration Broker services. This schema is transcribed from PeopleTools PeopleBooks, Reporting Web Services, 'Executing the Query' (https://docs.oracle.com/cd/E92519_02/pt856pbr3/eng/pt/trws/task_ExecutingtheQuery-5e7fb0.html, fetched 2026-10-20): the delivered service operation QAS_EXECUTEQRY_REST_GET at <node>/ExecuteQuery.v1/<OwnerType>/<QueryName>/<OutResultType>/<OutResultFormat>, here JSON/NONFILE with json_resp=true, answered with 'status' ('success' or 'fail') and 'data': for NONFILE results 'data.query' holds 'numrows', the query's name and 'rows', each row 'attr:rownumber' and one key per returned field (a column the query names; its value a string, a number or null). PeopleBooks' example spells the name's key 'queryname=' (sic), so both spellings are allowed. A refusal answers 'fail' with 'data' a message.
